requirements.title: Direct Order Confirmation Flow (Skip Payment & Address)
requirements.clause: Given the customer has dynamically selected eligible products in the cart with dynamic quantities (10-15) meeting the ৳10,000 minimum, clicking 'Proceed to Checkout →' skips payment method selection and shipping address entry, navigating directly to Order Confirmation page.

requirements.title: Default Registration Address Used as Shipping Address
requirements.clause: When completing checkout for dynamically selected eligible products, the order uses the customer's default registration address as shipping address without presenting any option to change address during checkout.

requirements.title: Order Placed Regardless of Credit Limit (ERP Sync)
requirements.clause: When customer attempts to place an order having exceeded credit limit, the system allows the order to go through and creates the order in the ERP system.
